story.fullStory:
The Kinks's "Waterloo Sunset" — original release 1972. "Waterloo Sunset" is a song by the English rock band the Kinks.

It was released as a single on 5 May 1967 and featured on the album Something Else by the Kinks in September that year.

Written and produced by Kinks frontman Ray Davies, "Waterloo Sunset" is one of the band's best-known and most acclaimed songs, and was ranked number 14 on the 2021 edition of Rolling Stone's 500 Greatest Songs of All Time list.

The Kink Kontroversy is the third studio album by the English rock band the Kinks.

Written and produced by Kinks frontman Ray Davies, "Waterloo Sunset" is one of the band's best-known and most acclaimed songs, and was ranked number 14 on the 2021 edition of Rolling Stone's 500 Greatest Songs of All Time list.
The Kink Kontroversy is the third studio album by the English rock band the Kinks.
Issued in the United States on 30 March 1966 by Reprise Records, it was the Kinks' first American album to feature an identical track listing to its British counterpart.
The song appears on the album "The Kink Kronikles" (1972).
